name: marketpilot-ai
description: Explainable multi-asset market intelligence and paper-trading platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,ml -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=@marketpilot/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@marketpilot/api" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir apps/ml-service --port 8000"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@marketpilot/types && npm run build --workspace=@marketpilot/web && npm run build --workspace=@marketpilot/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@marketpilot/types && npm run typecheck --workspace=@marketpilot/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@marketpilot/api
